summary: Arrow buttons within the book GUI are rendered above tooltips
description:
## The Bug:

Arrow buttons within the book GUI are rendered above tooltips.

## Steps to Reproduce:

 - Place down a command block and input the following command into it.

/give @p minecraft:written_book{pages:['[{"text":"\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\nMC-75721\\n","color":"red","hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","value":"MC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721"}}]','[{"text":"\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\nMC-75721\\n","color":"red","hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","value":"MC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721"}}]'],title:MC-75721,author:MC-75721}

 - Activate the command block in order to receive a book.

 - Open the book and hold your mouse cursor over the red text displayed within it.

 - Take note as to whether or not arrow buttons within the book GUI are rendered above tooltips.

## Observed Behavior:

Arrow buttons are rendered in front tooltips.

## Expected Behavior:

Arrow buttons would be rendered behind tooltips.

## Code Analysis:

Code analysis by Tobi14601 can be found in this comment.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft and create a Creative world with default settings.
2. Place a command block and enter `/give @p minecraft:written_book{pages:['[{"text":"\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\nMC-75721\\n","color":"red","hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","value":"MC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721"}}]','[{"text":"\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\nMC-75721\\n","color":"red","hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","value":"MC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721\\nMC-75721 MC-75721"}}]'],title:MC-75721,author:MC-75721}`.
3. Activate the command block to receive the written book.
4. Open the written book.
5. Move the mouse cursor over the red text displayed in the book.
6. Observe that the book's arrow buttons are rendered in front of the tooltip.
Observed Behavior: When the cursor is held over the red text in the written-book GUI, its `show_text` hover tooltip is displayed across the book interface. If the tooltip overlaps the book’s page-navigation arrow buttons, the buttons are rendered on top of the tooltip rather than behind it. This causes the arrow buttons to remain visible above and obscure the corresponding portion of the tooltip.
Expected Behavior: When hovering over text in the book GUI, the tooltip should be rendered in front of all book interface elements, including the page-navigation arrow buttons. The arrows should remain visually behind the tooltip rather than overlapping or obscuring it, ensuring that the tooltip is fully readable and displayed at the proper interface layer.
